thread:
Maya: noticing a canary anomaly for rollout r-2026-03-15-14 — sudden surge in 5xx and TCP RSTs on /v1/chat, canary at 7%

deploy-bot: Canary r-2026-03-15-14 started (7% cut). rollout id: r-2026-03-15-14

Maya: symptoms: ingress logs show repeated `connection reset by peer` and upstream closed headers. healthcheck failing on 4/6 canary pods.

Ben: paging oncall, alert svc:canary-5xx-rate exceeded (window=5m). If it's >5% impact or >2 unhealthy pods we abort per policy.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-20260315-55 created, severity=P2. Channel #inc-INC-20260315-55. On-call: Maya.

Maya: running quick `kubectl get pods` + `kubectl logs` — attaching snippet:
```
ingress-proxy 2026-03-15T19:12:03Z error: read tcp 10.12.0.8:443->10.12.1.21:51233: read: connection reset by peer
ingress-proxy 2026-03-15T19:12:04Z error: upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream
runtime    2026-03-15T19:12:04Z warn: grpc: transport is closing
```

Luis: LB metrics show spike in RSTs and dropped connections around 19:12. Kernel dmesg on nodes shows no OOM. Could be grpc runtime closing sockets under pressure or mis-handled keepalive.

Priya: quick mitigation plan: (1) abort canary, (2) flip `inference_v2_pipeline` flag to fallback stable path, (3) collect artifacts. Anyone object?

Ben: +1, meets abort criteria. Maya, trigger abort and route to stable. Priya please flip flag.

Maya: @deploy-bot abort-canary r-2026-03-15-14
deploy-bot: Abort received for r-2026-03-15-14. Initiating abort: draining canary pods and routing traffic to stable.

Priya: toggled feature flag `inference_v2_pipeline` -> false for all customers. Routing now pinned to stable v3.2.4. :white_check_mark:

Maya: monitoring — ingress 5xx dropping to baseline in ~45s after abort. RST rate on LB returning to normal.

Luis: grabbing runtime logs and core dump check. No coredumps, but runtime shows repeated `transport is closing` and `deadline exceeded` in stacktrace windows. Pulling tcp_keepalive and net.ipv4.tcp_fin_timeout from node metrics.

Ben: customer impact estimate: error window ~19:12:03–19:13:10 UTC, approx 1.9k failed requests (rough calc from request count). Low percent of global traffic but still user-visible for some sessions. Flagging as partial outage.

Priya: created postmortem task PM-20260315-04, assigned to eng-runtime + infra. Required: reproduce with local load balancer + grpc keepalive mismatch, validate kernel conn limit and proxy idle timeouts, add metric for upstream RSTs.

Maya: handoff to Ben for evidence and timeline consolidation. I'll collect the raw logs and upload to incident ticket before I step out. Call me if it reoccurs. :phone:

Ben: taking over. Status: mitigated (canary aborted, traffic stabilized). Open actions: investigate grpc keepalive settings mismatch between ingress and runtime; increase observability on transport close reasons; consider increasing canary healthcheck stringency and add RST-based abort rule.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-55 status updated to "Mitigated" by Ben. Postmortem due in 72 hours.

Maya: thanks all. Will link logs + timeline in the incident channel in 15m.
